'''Five Brothers Resort and Casino''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] located in the [[Centerpoint Station]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It purchased exclusive rights to the use of [[Conical Six]], one of the [[Southern Conical Mountains]] in the [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. [[Sura]] and [[Jek Bannon]] were employees of the casino.<ref name="SoF" />
